results.title: Sinoboom launches collision avoidance technology for scissor lifts
results.description: Sinoboom has introduced an advanced collision avoidance system for scissor lifts and mast lifts, designed to address the various shortcomings of standard single-sensor systems currently in the market, such as detection blind spots, high rates of false alarms, and lack of adaptability to multiple scenarios.
